scope: Composed JavaScript race with original physics, AI, contacts, bonuses and timers. A test-only route follower supplies ordinary analog controls. No poses, velocities, triggers, pickups, timers, or physics tables are changed. This is not an original Windows full-process comparison or a full-campaign UI run.
testDriverPolicy: Private closed-loop authored-road optimizer minimizes distance plus turnPenalty*(1-cos(angle)); selected nodes/cost recorded. Every selected edge is an original rail-prechecked DMP link; original linked-road follower with its optional detour planner disabled; production obstacles and collision responses remain active. Ordinary inputs only.
